name: Search demo
description: A reference search hook with no network at all: it recognises a few film series by the names people actually type and offers their titles as an attributed section under your own results. Used by the test harness.
author: Multipass

pages.title: A series the search demo knows

settings.label: Answer this slowly
settings.help: Milliseconds to wait before answering. Set it past a quarter of a second to see what a slow provider costs: the section arrives a keystroke late instead of holding up your results. No real plugin should do this.
